description.value: Fire+ Water Restaurant is the fine-dining establishment located inside the Victoria Marriott Inner Harbour, one of Victoria's prominent downtown waterfront hotels. The restaurant takes its name from a culinary theme of contrasting cooking elements and is positioned to serve hotel guests and the broader public in the heart of the city. For a touring cyclist, it represents a full-service sit-down dining option in a major hotel steps from the Inner Harbour.
